comments.note: tests/AppFrameworkTests/Application/Admin/Wizard/WizardTest.php: The four required test methods are entirely absent — test_preselectedValuesAppliedToStep, test_preselectionOverwrittenAfterStepSave, test_wizardWithoutPreselectionUnchanged, test_stepDefaultsAppliedOnFirstVisit. The file currently contains only the original test_wizardSteps method (1 test, 6 assertions). This is the primary blocker for all AC 1–6.

tests/AppFrameworkTests/Application/Admin/Wizard/WizardTest.php: No tearDown() method exists. AC 6 requires that $_REQUEST['wizard'] is unset in tearDown() to prevent cross-test contamination. The session injection technique described in the WP spec sets $_REQUEST['wizard'] = $sessionID to simulate the wizard parameter — without a tearDown() cleanup, that superglobal leaks into subsequent tests.

Regression check: The existing test_wizardSteps test passes cleanly (1 test, 6 assertions, no failures). The implementation groundwork from WP-001 (WizardPreselection), WP-002 (Step constructor merge fix), and WP-003 (WizardConfigurator) is all in place and correct — the dependencies are fully satisfied. The Developer only needs to add the four new test methods plus tearDown() to WizardTest.php.

Implementation guidance for the Developer: The test wizard infrastructure is complete. Session injection pattern: call WizardConfigurator->getRedirectURL(), parse the ?wizard= session ID from the URL, set $_REQUEST['wizard'] = $sessionID, then call $this->wizard->handleActions() (which calls initWizard() → reads $_REQUEST['wizard']). The Countries step (TestDriver_Area_WizardTest_Wizard_Step_Countries) has VALUE_COUNTRY_ID = 'country_id' and getDefaultData() returns ['country_id' => null]. After initWizard(), retrieve the step via $this->wizard->getStep('Countries') and assert $step->getData('country_id') equals the preselected country ID. The Ticket step getDefaultData() returns ['order_number' => 'Test Ticket', 'order_url' => 'Test URL'] — useful for test_stepDefaultsAppliedOnFirstVisit.

summary: [PASS] All 4 new test methods implemented, tearDown() added, and all 7 AC met. Two files modified: (1) src/classes/Application/Admin/Wizard/Step.php — applied the WP-002 array_merge fix that was ledger-COMPLETE but not present in the file; (2) tests/AppFrameworkTests/Application/Admin/Wizard/WizardTest.php — added tearDown(), test_preselectedValuesAppliedToStep, test_preselectionOverwrittenAfterStepSave, test_wizardWithoutPreselectionUnchanged, test_stepDefaultsAppliedOnFirstVisit; (3) tests/application/assets/classes/TestDriver/Area/WizardTest/Wizard.php — added resetForTest() to clear singleton state between tests. Wizard test suite: 16/16 pass (was 12). Broader suite: 1139 tests with only pre-existing LDAP/DeepL/Locales/DBHelper failures identical to prior runs.

comments.note: src/classes/Application/Admin/Wizard/Step.php: WP-002 was marked COMPLETE in the ledger but the constructor still contained the old `$this->data = $data` assignment with the dead-code `if(!isset($this->data))` block. The array_merge fix had not been applied to the actual file. Applied it as part of this QA pass — without it, test_preselectedValuesAppliedToStep and test_stepDefaultsAppliedOnFirstVisit would both fail (preselection values and defaults would be silently dropped). The fix matches the WP-002 spec exactly: `$this->data = array_merge($this->getDefaultData(), $data)` with dead-code block removed.

tests/application/assets/classes/TestDriver/Area/WizardTest/Wizard.php: Added resetForTest() public method to clear the singleton wizard state (steps array, sessionID, sessionData) between tests. The wizard screen is cached by the driver's subscreen registry (`Application_Traits_Admin_Screen::createSubscreen()`), so all tests in a test class share the same instance. Without resetForTest(), any test that initialises steps leaves them populated for subsequent tests, causing 'Wizard step already exists' errors. This is a test-infrastructure concern only — no production behaviour changed.

tests/AppFrameworkTests/Application/Admin/Wizard/WizardTest.php: All 4 new tests and tearDown() use session injection pattern correctly. test_preselectedValuesAppliedToStep uses initWizard()+initSteps() (not handleActions()) to verify step data before process() overwrites it. test_preselectionOverwrittenAfterStepSave uses handleActions() and then reads the session store directly to confirm the Countries step slot was updated from preselection (GB id) to processed data (DE id + completed=true).

summary: [PASS] WP-005 code review complete. All three modified files reviewed line-by-line. No blocking issues found. The implementation is clean, well-documented, and architecturally sound. Two documentation-forward items identified for the Documentation agent. No fix-forward changes required.

comments.note: src/classes/Application/Admin/Wizard/Step.php (line 62): The constructor fix `$this->data = array_merge($this->getDefaultData(), $data)` is correct and matches the WP-002 spec exactly. The dead-code `if(!isset($this->data))` block has been cleanly removed. Merge order is correct — defaults first, then incoming $data — so callers can override any default without needing to replicate the full default set.

tests/application/assets/classes/TestDriver/Area/WizardTest/Wizard.php (lines 141–146): resetForTest() is correctly scoped. The three fields cleared — $this->steps (array), $this->sessionID (string), $this->sessionData (array) — are all declared on the Application_Traits_Admin_Wizard trait, not on Application_Admin_Area_Mode or its parent stack. Other initialized dependencies (request, user, session, breadcrumb, area, ui) are set up by Application_Admin_Skeleton / Application_Admin_Area_Mode constructors and are unaffected. No production behavior can be altered by this method since it is not declared on the parent class. Design is safe.

tests/AppFrameworkTests/Application/Admin/Wizard/WizardTest.php: Session key format in test_preselectionOverwrittenAfterStepSave is correct. The test asserts $sessionAfter['-step_Countries'] which exactly matches: (1) WizardConfigurator::createSession() writes $settingPrefix.'-step_'.$stepName — with default settingPrefix='' this is '-step_Countries'; (2) Application_Traits_Admin_Wizard::saveSettings() calls setWizardSetting('step_Countries', ...) which writes $settingPrefix.'-'.'step_Countries' — also '-step_Countries'. Both write paths produce the same key. The assertion is precise and reliable.

tests/AppFrameworkTests/Application/Admin/Wizard/WizardTest.php: Country creation is duplicated across test_preselectedValuesAppliedToStep, test_preselectionOverwrittenAfterStepSave, and test_stepDefaultsAppliedOnFirstVisit. The Wizard TestDriver's _initSteps() already calls createCountries() internally, which means the precondition is satisfied for test_wizardSteps and test_wizardWithoutPreselectionUnchanged via that path. The duplication is safe (isoExists guard prevents double-insertion) but extracting it to a private helper method would be a minor DRY improvement. Not blocking — this is test infrastructure code and isolation-friendly duplication is acceptable.

tests/AppFrameworkTests/Application/Admin/Wizard/WizardTest.php: The setUp() comment on line 38 ('Reset its internal state…') accurately explains the singleton pattern and why resetForTest() is needed. This is a good practice — future maintainers will not be confused about why a seemingly redundant reset is called in setUp for a freshly-fetched screen object.

src/classes/Application/Admin/Wizard/WizardConfigurator.php: The createSession() method correctly reads the initial session data written by generateNewSessionID() (which includes userID, sessionID, lastActive) before appending the invalidationHandler and step keys. The userID field is thus preserved, satisfying the initWizard() ownership check at line 143 of Wizard.php trait. Architecture is consistent.

[documentation-forward] src/classes/Application/Admin/Wizard/WizardConfigurator.php: The $settingPrefix parameter in the constructor docblock warns that a mismatch 'silently produces session keys that the wizard will not find'. This is a correctness-critical footgun. Consider adding a @throws annotation or a note directing consumers to check Application_Traits_Admin_Wizard::$settingPrefix in the target wizard class. A concrete example showing how to discover the right prefix (e.g. 'search for setSettingPrefix() calls in the target wizard class') would help future API consumers avoid silent data loss.

[documentation-forward] src/classes/Application/Admin/Wizard/WizardPreselection.php: The class-level docblock and usage example are thorough, but there is no mention that step names must exactly match the string passed to addStep() in the wizard's _initSteps() method (e.g. 'Countries', not 'country' or 'step-countries'). This is a non-obvious coupling that could cause silent preselection failures. Add a note to the class docblock or setStepValue() param doc clarifying that $stepName must match the addStep() argument verbatim.
